newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly easier in thin after-hours trade on Monday, pressured by technically driven sales, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen per kg lower to 0.1 yen higher than the day's close. Benchmark May was 0.1 yen firmer at 143.3 yen. Volume was 2,352 lots.

During the day, prices were a tad firmer as rainfall in producing countries and recent falls in domestic rubber stocks made sellers cautious. "The market is basically looking for direction, and narrow-range trade is likely to continue," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
